# Source: Allegory of Spring, or the Young Gardeners

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Allegory of Spring, or the Young Gardeners
- **Artist / culture:** Jean Antoine Watteau French, 1684-1721
- **Date:** n.d.
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** chalk
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 84279
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/84279
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/e1fd71da-459c-0c2a-9420-5f6fc151b4ab/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Spring

## Extracted source palette

`#B8A888, #C8B8A8, #A88878, #887868, #A87858`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#473E36`
- `surface`: `#5B544D`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B8A888`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#A87858`
- `surface_variant`: `#5C544D`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#79726C`
- `error`: `#B8A888`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `9.82:1`, surface `7.0:1`
- Variant contrast: `6.98:1`
- Control contrast: `8.37:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
